title: Advances, challenges, and opportunities for legged robots
description:
arXiv:2607.28952v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humanoid and quadrupedal robots have the potential to revolutionize the way we work, interact, and coexist with intelligent machines. To understand their effects on society and how they can enable scientific discovery, we assess the current capabilities of these systems along hardware, locomotion, autonomy, data, and applications.
